cues.en: C⁰ and G⁰ are equivalent, and they are both positional continuity

cues.zh: 基本上就是说，曲线只是在位置上相连
cues.en: It basically means your curves are simply connected in position

cues.zh: C¹ 是速度连续性
cues.en: C¹ is velocity continuity

cues.zh: 也就是说，一阶导数连续，位置也连续
cues.en: as in, the first derivative is continuous, and, the position is also continuous

cues.zh: 换句话说，仅速度本身连续还不够
cues.en: In other words, it’s not enough for the velocity to be continuous on its own

cues.zh: 之前的各阶导数也必须连续
cues.en: the previous derivatives have to be continuous as well

cues.zh: G¹ 是切线连续性，它也要求位置连续
cues.en: G¹ is tangent continuity, which also requires that it has positional continuity

cues.zh: 这个规律继续下去
cues.en: And, this same pattern continues

cues.zh: C² 是加速度连续性，这也意味着速度连续，
cues.en: C² is acceleration continuity, which also implies velocity continuity,

cues.zh: 进而意味着位置连续。你懂这个意思
cues.en: which also implies positional continuity. You get the idea

cues.zh: C³ 是急动度连续性
cues.en: C³ is jolt continuity

cues.zh: G² 是曲率连续性，同样意味着前面那些连续性
cues.en: G² is curvature continuity, which again, implies the previous ones

cues.zh: 最后是 G³，在我看来，它被错误地称为“挠率”连续性，
cues.en: Finally, we have G³, which, in my opinion, is incorrectly called “torsion” continuity,

cues.zh: 有时也被错误地称为加速度连续性
cues.en: it’s also sometimes incorrectly called acceleration continuity

cues.zh: 遗憾的是，我也不知道有什么好名字，
cues.en: I don’t know of a good name for this unfortunately,

cues.zh: 但它实际上指的是曲率的变化率
cues.en: but it’s effectively referring to the rate of change of curvature

cues.zh: 依此类推！可以一直继续下去，直到 C∞ 和 G∞
cues.en: And so on! We can go on forever, until C∞ and G∞

cues.zh: 就像所有参数连续性都包含之前所有级别一样，
cues.en: Now, just like all the parametric continuities include all previous levels,

cues.zh: 几何连续性也包含之前所有级别，
cues.en: and geometric continuity includes all their previous levels,

cues.zh: 这里还有另一个联系
cues.en: there’s another connection here

cues.zh: C¹ 连续也必然是 G¹ 连续
cues.en: C¹ continuity is also necessarily G¹ continuous

cues.zh: 如果还记得，镜像的切点也是对齐的
cues.en: If you remember, mirrored tangent points are also aligned

cues.zh: 实际上，G 连续没有 C 连续那么严格
cues.en: Effectively, G-continuity is less strict than C-continuity

cues.zh: 所以 C 连续性实际上也蕴含对应的几何连续性，
cues.en: so the C continuities actually imply their corresponding geometric continuity as well,

cues.zh: 但反过来不成立
cues.en: but, not the other way around

cues.zh: ……一般来说
cues.en: …generally

cues.zh: 在有人评论“其实吧”之前，我得先补充一个小前提。
cues.en: before someone comments going “well actually”, I have to throw in a little caveat.

cues.zh: 这个蕴含关系只在曲线是正则时才成立
cues.en: This implication only applies if the curves are regular

cues.zh: 这就有点数学时刻了，因为这里的“正则”当然有特定含义，
cues.en: Now this is a bit of a, math moment, because of course “regular” has a particular meaning here,

cues.zh: 并不是这个词日常的“常规”意思
cues.en: that isn’t the regular meaning of the word

cues.zh: 正则曲线就是速度从不为 0 的曲线
cues.en: A regular curve is one where the velocity is never 0

cues.zh: 换句话说，它从不会完全停住
cues.en: In other words, it never stands perfectly still

cues.zh: 事实上，如果让这种情况发生，我们一直在讲的很多数学就彻底失效了
cues.en: In fact, if we let this happen, a lot of our math we’ve been talking about breaks down completely

cues.zh: 无论是求切线方向，还是计算曲率，
cues.en: Both getting the tangent direction, and calculating the curvature,

cues.zh: 只要存在速度为 0 的点，就会除以 0
cues.en: divides by 0 if there is a point with 0 speed

cues.zh: 要构造出带这种病态行为的曲线相对困难，但并非不可能
cues.en: It’s relatively hard to create a curve with this pathological behavior, but, not impossible

cues.zh: 比如，看这条贝塞尔曲线
cues.en: For example, take this bézier curve

cues.zh: 如果我们把切点放在这个确切位置，就制造出了一个速度为 0 的点
cues.en: If we place the tangent points at this exact location, we’ve created a point with 0 speed

cues.zh: 曲线完全连续，但看看切线会发生什么
cues.en: The curve is fully continuous, but watch what happens to the tangent

cues.zh: 它会瞬间翻转，这意味着切线不连续
cues.en: It instantaneously flips, which means it has a tangent discontinuity

cues.zh: 这叫做尖点（cusp），也是少数罕见例外之一，其中
cues.en: This is called a cusp, and it’s one of those rare exceptions where the

cues.zh: 曲线是 C∞ 的，但在这一点上只有 G⁰ 连续
cues.en: curve is C∞ but only G⁰ continuous, at this point

cues.zh: 到目前为止，我们只讨论了 Bézier 样条
cues.en: We’ve only been talking about Bézier splines so far

cues.zh: 但现在我们有了这个分析连续性的极其强大的工具
cues.en: but now that we’re equipped with this extremely powerful tool to analyze continuity

cues.zh: 我觉得该去看看扩展宇宙里的其他样条了
cues.en: I think it’s time to visit the other splines in the extended universe

cues.zh: 虽然 Bézier 曲线很有用，但它的点挺奇怪的，不是吗？
cues.en: While the bézier curve is useful, its points are pretty, strange, are they not?

cues.zh: 除了起点和终点，它们并没有真正指向任何具体的东西
cues.en: They don’t really refer to anything specific, except the start and the end point

cues.zh: 如果我们能想出另一种更有物理意义的样条呢？
cues.en: What if, we can come up with another type of spline, that makes more physical sense?

cues.zh: 如果不再提供 4 个点，而是像往常一样设定起点和终点
cues.en: What if instead of supplying 4 points, we set the start and end point, as usual

cues.zh: 但接着，我们也设定起点和终点的速度
cues.en: but then, we also set the start and end velocities

cues.zh: 换个角度看——我们提供的是位置上的边界和
cues.en: Another way of looking at it - we’re supplying the boundary in position and

cues.zh: 速度上的边界，然后求解二者之间的连接
cues.en: the boundary in velocity, and then solving for the connection between

cues.zh: 这在模拟物理对象时可能非常有用，
cues.en: This could be really useful when simulating physical objects,

cues.zh: 甚至在网络中插值运动数据时也很有用
cues.en: or even when interpolating movement data across a network

cues.zh: 这意味着我们会得到一条自动满足这些约束的样条
cues.en: This means we’ll have a spline that automatically satisfies these constraints

cues.zh: 它会自动计算加速度和加加速度，来生成这条曲线
cues.en: It effectively auto-calculates the acceleration and jolt, to make this curve

cues.zh: 构造出这条样条其实相当直接！
cues.en: Coming up with this spline is actually pretty straightforward!

cues.zh: 和做任何数学题一样，先列出已知值，
cues.en: As with any other math problem, let’s list our known values,

cues.zh: 以及约束条件，然后从那里求解
cues.en: and our constraints, and solve from there

cues.zh: 曲线的起点应该在 P₀
cues.en: The start of the curve should be at P₀

cues.zh: 曲线的终点应该在 P₁
cues.en: The end of the curve should be at P₁

cues.zh: 起点处的速度应该是 v₀
cues.en: The velocity at the start should be v₀

cues.zh: 终点处的速度应该是 v₁
cues.en: The velocity at the end should be v₁

cues.zh: 4 个方程意味着有 4 个未知变量要求解，
cues.en: 4 equations means 4 unknown variables to solve for,

cues.zh: 也就是说我们可以用三次多项式，求解 a、b、c 和 d
cues.en: which means we can use a cubic polynomial, solving for a, b, c and d

cues.zh: 比如，其中一个只要看一眼就能立刻确定
cues.en: For example, one of them we can figure out immediately just by looking at it

cues.zh: 如果方程在 t = 0 时应该给出 P₀，
cues.en: If the equation should give us P₀ when t = 0,

cues.zh: 那么 a、b、c 都乘以 0，这意味着 d 必须是 P₀
cues.en: then a, b and c are all multiplied by 0, this means that d has to be P₀

cues.zh: t = 0 时的导数同理，c 必须是 v₀
cues.en: The same goes for the derivative when t = 0, c has to be v₀

cues.zh: 以此类推！
cues.en: And so on!

cues.zh: 中间步骤我就不一一展示了，
cues.en: I’ll spare you all the intermediate steps,

cues.zh: 最终得到的是这个样条的矩阵形式
cues.en: here’s what we end up with, the matrix form of this spline

cues.zh: 现在你或许能看出矩阵形式的威力了
cues.en: Now you might see the power of the matrix form

cues.zh: 现在的设置和之前完全一样，
cues.en: We now have the exact same setup where,

cues.zh: 左边是 t 的幂矩阵，右边是点矩阵
cues.en: we have a powers of t matrix on the left, and a point matrix on the right

cues.zh: 中间则是特征矩阵，
cues.en: and then the characteristic matrix in the middle,

cues.zh: 这给了这个样条一种独特的指纹
cues.en: giving us a kind of unique fingerprint for this spline

cues.zh: 和之前一样，用 t 矩阵乘以特征矩阵，
cues.en: Just like before, multiplying the t-matrix by the characteristic matrix,

cues.zh: 就得到每个控制点的基函数
cues.en: gives us the basis function for each control point

cues.zh: 这就是我们新样条段的样子！
cues.en: This is what our new spline segment looks like!

cues.zh: 这个样条酷的地方在于，不再有任意切点
cues.en: The cool thing about this one is that there’s no more arbitrary tangent points

cues.zh: 它能保证处在特定位置，
cues.en: it’s a spline that guarantees being at a specific place,

cues.zh: 并在每个控制点具有特定速度，
cues.en: with a certain velocity, at every control point,

cues.zh: 让我们能很好地控制沿样条的动画
cues.en: giving us a lot of control over the animation across the spline

cues.zh: 如果分析一阶导数，也就是速度，
cues.en: If we analyze the first derivative, the velocity,

cues.zh: 你会看到它沿着这条样条在每个点都匹配，而且完全连续
cues.en: you can see it matches at every point along this spline, and it’s fully continuous

cues.zh: 不过你可能注意到，速度本身的变化看起来相当剧烈
cues.en: Though you might’ve noticed that the velocity itself looks like it changes pretty harshly

cues.zh: 所以，我们来看看变化率的变化率——加速度
cues.en: so, let’s look at the rate of change of the rate of change - acceleration

cues.zh: 这里，你能看到第一个真正的不连续点
cues.en: Here, you can see that we have our first proper discontinuity

cues.zh: 每个连接处都会发生加速度的瞬时变化
cues.en: There’s an instantaneous change of acceleration at each join

cues.zh: 换句话说，虽然这个样条不满足 C² 连续性的标准，但它始终是 C¹
cues.en: In other words, while this spline doesn’t meet the criteria for C² continuity, it is always C¹

cues.zh: 这类样条要为每个点提供显式速度，其实它有个名字！
cues.en: This type of spline where you supply explicit velocities at each point, actually has a name!

cues.zh: 它叫 Hermite 样条。
cues.en: This is called a Hermite spline.

cues.zh: 或者说，如果你是法国人，现在估计内心已经崩溃了
cues.en: Or, I mean, if you’re French you’re probably dying inside right now

cues.zh: 严格来说，我觉得它应该读成 [蹩脚法语口音] Hermite
cues.en: technically I think it’s supposed to be pronounced [bad french voice] Hermite

cues.zh: 但没人这么念，好吧，放我一马
cues.en: but nobody says it like that okay so cut me some slack

cues.zh: 总之，如你所见，Hermite 样条有显式导数
cues.en: Anyway, as you can see, the hermite spline has explicit derivatives

cues.zh: 而且，由于每段曲线连接处的两侧共享同一个速度，
cues.en: And since both sides of each curve join share the same velocity,

cues.zh: 它必然也是 C¹ 连续的
cues.en: it is also by necessity C¹ continuous

cues.zh: 还值得注意的是——很多 Hermite 样条允许每个连接处有两个速度
cues.en: It’s also worth noting - many hermite splines out there allow for two velocities per join

cues.zh: 一个给进入的曲线，一个给出去的曲线，
cues.en: one for the incoming curve, and one for the outgoing curve,

cues.zh: 如果你愿意，也能做出 C⁰ 拼接
cues.en: allowing you to make C⁰ joins as well if you like

cues.zh: 它也是插值的：会经过每个点和每个速度。
cues.en: It’s also interpolating, it’s passing through every point and every velocity.

cues.zh: 现在，Hermite 样条其实和贝塞尔样条关系非常密切
cues.en: Now, the hermite spline is actually very closely related to the bézier spline

cues.zh: 两者之间转换非常简单
cues.en: Converting between the two is trivially easy

cues.zh: 把每个速度除以三，再加上它的起点，就得到贝塞尔切点
cues.en: If you divide each velocity by three, and add its origin, you get the bezier tangent point

cues.zh: 把它翻到另一侧，就得到另一侧的贝塞尔控制点
cues.en: Flip that to the other side, and you now have the bézier control point for the other side

cues.zh: 这样得到的曲线和 Hermite 样条完全一样，只是改用贝塞尔形式来定义
cues.en: This creates the exact same curve as the hermite spline, but defined using béziers instead

cues.zh: 这也告诉我们，贝塞尔的切点，
cues.en: This also tells us that the bézier tangent points,

cues.zh: 正好对应连接处速度的三分之一
cues.en: correspond to exactly a third of the velocity at the join

cues.zh: 接下来是我们一直忽略的一种样条，
cues.en: Next up is a spline we’ve been neglecting this whole time,

cues.zh: 它可能是最流行的一种
cues.en: which might be the most popular one out there

cues.zh: 只是人们很少把它叫作样条
cues.en: People just rarely call it a spline

cues.zh: 线性样条！
cues.en: The linear spline!

cues.zh: 很简单，就是在每个点之间画直线
cues.en: Simply, drawing straight lines between each point

cues.zh: 我们可能会看不起这个简陋的基础样条，但它其实有几个超能力
cues.en: And we might scoff at this shitty little basic spline but it actually has a few superpowers

cues.zh: 首先，它经过每一个控制点！
cues.en: First, it’s passing through every control point!

cues.zh: 不搞多余的噱头，直接切入正题
cues.en: No unnecessary bells and whistles, just straight to the point

cues.zh: （没有双关的意思）
cues.en: (no pun intended)

cues.zh: 第二，它是少数几种弧长参数化很容易的样条之一！
cues.en: Second, it’s one of the few splines where arc-length parameterization is easy!

cues.zh: 弧长参数化是指你想以恒定速度插值一条曲线
cues.en: Arc length parameterization is when you want to interpolate a curve with a constant speed

cues.zh: 而对几乎所有现有样条来说，这其实都非常复杂
cues.en: which is actually very complicated for almost all splines out there

cues.zh: 第三，它的求值成本非常低！公式在这里，就是一个 lerp
cues.en: Third, it’s very cheap to evaluate! Here’s the formula, it’s just a lerp

cues.zh: 但不幸的是，它永远只有 C⁰ 连续
cues.en: But, unfortunately, it’s only ever C⁰ continuous

cues.zh: 不过，这种经过你提供的每个点的性质非常有用
cues.en: This property of passing through every point you supply is very useful though

cues.zh: 所以我们可能会问，能不能做出更平滑的样条，
cues.en: so we might ask, is it possible to make a smoother spline,

cues.zh: 让它经过所有这些点，又不用指定导数？
cues.en: that will pass through them all, without having to specify derivatives?

cues.zh: 一种方法是采用与 Hermite 样条类似的策略
cues.en: One method, is to use a similar strategy as the hermite spline

cues.zh: 但不是自己提供速度，
cues.en: but instead of supplying the velocities ourselves,

cues.zh: 如果我们根据相邻点来计算它们会怎样？
cues.en: what if we calculate them based on neighboring points?

cues.zh: 我们只需在相邻点之间画一个向量，把它当作速度
cues.en: We simply draw a vector between the neighboring points, and use that as our velocity

cues.zh: 然后对每个点重复这个过程
cues.en: And we repeat this process for every point

cues.zh: 查看相邻点，构成一个向量，把它当作速度，依此类推。
cues.en: Look at the neighbors, form a vector, use that as our velocity, and so on.

cues.zh: 这就是得到的曲线
cues.en: This is the curve we get

cues.zh: 现在它并不完美，还有几个问题
cues.en: Now, it’s not, perfect, there are a few problems

cues.zh: 首先，它实际上没有穿过端点，
cues.en: First, it doesn’t actually pass through the endpoints,

cues.zh: 因为端点缺少一个相邻点来计算速度 :(
cues.en: because they’re missing one of their neighbors to calculate a velocity from :(

cues.zh: 不过我们可以稍微假装有一个额外的点，
cues.en: But, we can sort of, pretend we have an extra point,

cues.zh: 它就是第二个相邻点镜像出来的
cues.en: that’s just the second adjacent point mirrored

cues.zh: 这样就能把曲线延伸到端点
cues.en: This lets us extend the curve to the endpoints

cues.zh: 对最后一个点也做同样处理
cues.en: And we do the same for the last point

cues.zh: 把倒数第二个点绕最后一个点镜像，创建这个虚拟点
cues.en: mirror the second last point around the last one, to create this, ghost point

cues.zh: 我们可能注意到的第二点是，这个形状，
cues.en: The second thing we might notice, is that the shape is,

cues.zh: 有点奇怪，对吧？当然无意冒犯这条样条，只是它相当凹凸不平
cues.en: kinda weird isn’t it? No offense to this spline of course but it’s rather, lumpy

cues.zh: 比如，这里这一段非常平
cues.en: For example, this part right here is very flat

cues.zh: 而这一段，在平坦区域附近有相当急的转弯
cues.en: And this part, has a pretty sharp turn around flat sections

cues.zh: 分析这个的好工具是曲率梳
cues.en: A good tool for analyzing this is the curvature comb

cues.zh: 现在可以清楚看到这条样条上曲率的剧烈变化
cues.en: We can now clearly see the radical change in curvature across this spline

cues.zh: 这个急转弯现在有非常明显的凸起
cues.en: this sharp turn now has a very clear bump

cues.zh: 而这个平坦段曲率明显降到接近 0，意味着它是线性的，或者说，是平的
cues.en: and this flat section very clearly has curvature drop to almost 0, meaning it’s linear, or, flat

cues.zh: 也许该想办法缓解这些急转弯和平坦段
cues.en: Maybe it’s a good idea to find some way to mitigate these sharp turns and flat sections

cues.zh: 如果我们给所有这些速度乘一个缩放因子会怎样？
cues.en: What if we apply a scale factor to all these velocities?

cues.zh: 只需用一个值把它们整体缩小
cues.en: Just, scale them all down by some value

cues.zh: 可以看到，曲线变得平缓多了
cues.en: You can see the curve becomes much more relaxed

cues.zh: 继续这样下去，它实际上会趋近于线性样条
cues.en: And as we continue, it actually approaches the linear spline

cues.zh: 所以有了这个缩放参数，我们就能更好地控制曲线的尖锐程度
cues.en: So with this scale parameter, we have a lot more control over the sharpness of the curve

cues.zh: 把曲率梳调出来，可以看到缩放值很低时，
cues.en: Bringing back the curvature comb, you can see that with a low scale,

cues.zh: 连接处的曲率非常极端，而在大部分线段上会迅速变平
cues.en: the curvature is extreme at the joins, and quickly flattens along most of the segments

cues.zh: 增大缩放值，曲线会变得平缓得多，
cues.en: Increase the scale, and the curve becomes much more relaxed,

cues.zh: 但在缩放值为 1 时又会变得有点起伏
cues.en: before getting a little bumpy again at a scale of 1

cues.zh: 这种带自动切线的样条，
cues.en: This type of spline with automatic tangents,

cues.zh: 带一个缩放参数，并插值所有点，叫做基数样条
cues.en: a scale parameter, and interpolating all points, is called a cardinal spline

cues.zh: 它的矩阵形式是这样的！
